corpusName: Lincoln Deep Corpus (28-document reviewed baseline; LMA v4 inventories complete)
samplingFrame: Core 28-document reviewed baseline drawn from Abraham Lincoln's speeches, letters, and public addresses (1838-1865), fully annotated in lincoln-metaphor-analysis (pipeline_stage_completed: 4 in the source manifest). LMA v4 source inventories are now complete through the non-human-review boundary: 48 core documents, 78 validation-tier documents, and 18 additional search-only reference documents. PPW currently registers 36 document metadata records; the remaining LMA v4 inventory records require PPW source-pack mapping, raw-text import, segmentation, annotation/reliability review, and claim-promotion gates before they become PPW evidence.
notes: PPW #194 (migrated from LMA #109) defined the three-tier corpus expansion architecture. LMA has now completed source inventories for LMA #113 (48-document core), LMA #114 (78-document validation inventory), and LMA #115 (18 additional search-only reference records). PPW still distinguishes source inventory completion from evidence readiness: documentCount (28) reflects the reviewed/deep baseline, registeredDocumentCount (36) reflects current PPW document metadata records, and the LMA v4 sourceInventoryCounts require follow-on PPW import/review work. Raw text import, passage segmentation, annotation, human/inter-annotator review, scoring, and claim promotion remain pending.
